title: BitMine تشتري 34% مزيدًا من الإيثر وسط تراجع الأسعار وتؤكد إيمانها بدورة إيثريوم الصاعدة
subTitle:
تواصل شركة BitMine Immersion Technologies تعزيز محفظتها الرقمية بوتيرة متسارعة، إذ ارتفعت مشترياتها من الإيثر (ETH) الأسبوع الماضي بنسبة 34% مقارنة بالأسبوع السابق، في ظل انخفاض أسعار السوق.

وأعلنت الشركة يوم الإثنين عن شراء 110,288 إيثر، لترتفع حيازتها الإجمالية إلى 3,505,723 ETH بمتوسط سعر شراء يبلغ 3,639 دولارًا لكل توكن.

وفي بيان الإعلان، قال رئيس الشركة توم لي إن انخفاض سعر الإيثر الأخير شكّل “فرصة جذابة” للشراء، مشيرًا إلى تزايد تبني إيثريوم في وول ستريت:

“من الواضح بالنسبة لي أن وول ستريت مهتمة جدًا بترميز الأصول على البلوكشين، مما يعزز الشفافية ويُطلق قيمة جديدة للمُصدرين والمستثمرين. هذه هي القصة الأساسية التي تدعم رؤيتنا لإيثريوم كقصة دورة فائقة خلال العقد المقبل.”
بدأت BitMine Immersion Technologies عملها كشركة تعدين للعملات المشفرة، لكنها أصبحت اليوم أكبر شركة خزانة لإيثريوم في العالم، حيث تُقدّر قيمة حيازاتها الإجمالية بنحو 12.5 مليار دولار.

وتهدف الشركة إلى امتلاك 5% من إجمالي المعروض من الإيثر البالغ 120,696,594 ETH، فيما ترفع الصفقة الأخيرة حصتها إلى 2.9%.

ويُعرف توم لي، وهو أيضًا المؤسس المشارك لشركة الأبحاث المالية Fundstrat، بتفاؤله الكبير تجاه سعر الإيثر. ففي منتصف أكتوبر، ومع اقتراب نهاية العام، توقّع أن يصل سعر الإيثر إلى ما بين 10,000 و12,000 دولار قبل نهاية عام 2025.
لكن في وقت كتابة التقرير، يتم تداول الإيثر عند 3,561 دولارًا، منخفضًا بنسبة 13.4% خلال الأسبوعين الماضيين وبنسبة 4.7% خلال الثلاثين يومًا الأخيرة. وعند هذه المستويات، تُظهر حيازة BitMine خسائر غير محققة، فيما يحتاج السعر إلى ارتفاع بنسبة 180% بحلول نهاية ديسمبر للوصول إلى توقع لي البالغ 10,000 دولار.

في المقابل، ارتفع سهم BitMine المُرمز (BMNR) بشكل كبير خلال عام 2025، محققًا قفزة تفوق 400% منذ بداية العام ليصل إلى 41.15 دولارًا وقت كتابة التقرير.

title: 以太坊大跌后迎来回升，市场是否重演2020年行情？
subTitle:
过去三个月，以太坊（#ETH ）可谓经历了一波过山车行情，从4960美元高位一路跌到接近3000美元低点。看到这一波下跌，不少分析师忍不住拿2020年的走势来对比——当年ETH也经历过类似回调，从490美元跌到308美元，然后强势反弹。
回调模式惊人相似
加密货币分析师Galaxy指出，这两次回调其实非常相似：
2020年ETH跌至308美元后开始大幅反弹2025年ETH跌至3064美元后，价格已经回升到3500美元以上
Galaxy认为，市场可能正在重演历史模式。不过，要注意的关键支撑区在3000-3100美元，如果价格能守住这一带，强劲反弹就有戏。


Cas Abbé也表示，类似的历史模式可能再次上演。今年以太坊价格的回调曾短暂触底，随后反弹了100%。近期ETH向3000美元的上涨，也可能是一轮假突破。
支撑位与阻力位较量
Lark Davis提醒，ETH目前仍守在自4月份以来的支撑趋势线上方，这条趋势线依然完好，但短期压力不小。


20日均线在3695美元附近构成阻力MACD指标接近金叉
戴维斯总结道：“支撑、阻力和动能之间的较量，某种力量即将发生转变。”ETH现在在两个关键价位之间震荡，突破或回落可能很快发生，一切取决于哪一方先让步。
巨鲸入场，流动性支撑上涨💰
Bitcoinsensus指出，ETH在3350美元低点附近的反弹，很可能得益于流动性涌入。下一个值得关注的区域在4950美元附近，既有阻力也有丰富流动性。
PRIME 𝕏报告显示，以太坊价格在3200美元附近时，大户开始大幅买入。如果3000-3400美元支撑位守住，4500-4800美元区间的目标价位很可能出现。巨鲸活跃操作为价格提供了支撑。
不过Ali Martinez提醒，上周有23位以太坊巨鲸进行了部分减仓或仓位调整，这可能对短期行情带来波动。
交易量和投机行为创新高
CryptoPotato数据显示，ETH的交易量和未平仓合约量已达到历史新高。这说明市场动能更多来自短期投机，而非长期持有。
BitMine最新披露，截止11月10日，该公司持有350万枚ETH，每枚价值约3639美元，同时还持有BTC和其他资产。尽管市场波动大，但机构投资者仍在坚定持有以太坊，这为市场提供了稳定性。
小结
以太坊目前正处于关键支撑位附近，历史走势和市场信号都显示，如果支撑位守住，ETH很可能迎来强劲反弹。巨鲸入场、流动性充足、交易量创新高，这些都是市场潜在上涨的信号。不过，短期投机行为活跃，也意味着价格可能随时波动。
对投资者来说，关注支撑和阻力位、巨鲸动向和成交量，将有助于判断下一步行情。#美国政府停摆

title: 巨鲸狂囤760万枚代币！以太坊大底已成定局？
subTitle:
#BTC #ETH #ETHUSDT #btcusdt 
以太坊的现货订单活动出现了明显的转变，这表明大型投资者正在以折价价格积累资产，这种行为模式在历史上往往预示着潜在的趋势逆转。
根据CryptoQuant的数据，持有1万至10万枚以太坊的“巨鲸”，自4月底以来已将其余额增加了760万枚代币，增幅高达52%。与此同时，持有100至1000枚以太坊的散户钱包却在大举抛售，持仓量减少了16%。
在11月初以太坊跌至3,000美元之后，执行交易量高于平均水平的现货指标被多次观察到。
CryptoQuant认证分析师ShayanMarkets表示，这种模式通常“标志着趋势逆转的开始，或者重大上涨前夕的末期压缩阶段”。
MEXC Research的首席分析师Shawn Young告诉Decrypt：“巨鲸积累形成局部底部的可能性仍然很高。”他补充道：“这个周期看起来与之前的底部非常相似，其特点是大型钱包正在吸收短期持有者的卖出流动性。”
Young指出，以太坊兑BTC汇率稳定在数月低点，是其相对强劲的一个迹象。此外，日交易量自9月水平增长了25%，并且在10月10日190亿美元市值蒸发后，质押的以太坊折价已趋于正常化，这些都进一步支撑了这一观点。
这一市场信号并非仅限于以太坊，它反映了更广泛的市场动态变化，其驱动力是宏观经济前景的改善，包括美国持续时间最长的政府停摆之一有可能结束。
Fisher8 Capital的投资分析师Lai Yuen告诉Decrypt：“巨鲸积累是合理的，我们在比特币身上也看到了同样的现象，新的参与者正在涌入，吸收那些坚信四年周期理论的‘老玩家’所带来的抛售压力。”
Yuen认为：“如果宏观经济状况继续保持良好……以太坊在3,200美元，以及比特币在98,000美元形成局部底部的可能性很高。”
Yuen还强调：“传统金融对资产代币化仍然充满期待，” 他指出，一个支持性的监管环境可能会提供进一步的催化剂。
Yuen补充说，一项正式的加密市场结构法案也有助于提振以太坊的价格，因为它能使市场渗透更大的清晰度，结束可能让投资者持观望态度的监管阴影。
不过，正如Decrypt此前报道，如果两党谈判要在今年恢复，政府停摆就需要尽快结束

Shorten Your Take Profit Target: Consistency Is the Key to Real Profit

In trading, focusing on a large take profit target often causes traders to lose sight of the essence: small but consistent profits are more impactful than large profits that occur rarely. For example, a 5% TP target with a 70% win rate can generate exponential account growth compared to a 20% TP with a 30% win rate that often damages capital.

The principle is simple: set realistic risk-reward, take profit at the first psychological level, and use a scale-out strategy. For example, take 50% of the position at TP1 and let the remaining portion trail the market movement. This way, daily profits of 0.5–1% can accumulate to 30–50% per month without excessive pressure.

The key to successful trading is not how large the profit is for each transaction, but how often the trader succeeds in making a profit. 30-day challenge: limit the maximum TP to 1.5x the risk and record the results - greed, not strategy, is usually what destroys traders.

Perpendek Target Take Profitmu: Konsistensi Adalah Kunci Profit Nyata

Dalam trading, fokus pada target take profit besar sering membuat trader kehilangan esensi: profit kecil tapi konsisten lebih berdampak daripada profit besar yang jarang terjadi. Misalnya, target TP 5% dengan win rate 70% bisa menghasilkan pertumbuhan akun eksponensial dibanding TP 20% dengan win rate 30% yang sering merusak modal.

Prinsipnya sederhana: tentukan risk-reward realistis, ambil profit di level psikologis pertama, dan gunakan strategi scale out. Contohnya, ambil 50% posisi di TP1 dan sisanya biarkan trailing stop mengikuti pergerakan pasar. Dengan cara ini, profit harian 0,5–1% bisa menumpuk menjadi 30–50% per bulan tanpa tekanan berlebih.

Kunci keberhasilan trading bukan pada seberapa besar profit tiap transaksi, tapi seberapa sering trader berhasil mencetak profit. Tantangan 30 hari: batasi TP maksimal 1,5x risiko dan catat hasilnya - greed, bukan strategi, biasanya yang menghancurkan trader.

translatedData.content:
《In the Cryptocurrency World, Not Losing Money is the First Lesson》

Many people enter the cryptocurrency world with dreams of getting rich overnight, but end up losing everything in a night.
The ones who make it to the end are not necessarily the ones who made the most profit, but rather the ones who were the most stable.

In the cryptocurrency world, the first step to not losing money is to "stay still".
Not every candlestick needs to be participated in, and not every fluctuation is worth betting on.
Watching the market for too long can lead to being driven by emotions—greed, fear, and impulse are all starting points for losses.

The second step is to "maintain discipline".
Set profit-taking and stop-loss points; avoid over-leveraging, averaging down, or going all-in.
Losing a little is okay; being able to control losses gives you the chance to see the next market trend.

The third step is to "have a rhythm".
Markets always have ups and downs; you can't hit the mark every time.
Being able to follow the trend and knowing how to wait is more important than chasing after every rise and fall.

In the cryptocurrency world, true experts are not those who make money every day,
but those who can remain unscathed when others face liquidation.

Remember this phrase—
Before making money, first learn not to lose money;
If you want to go far, don't rush to run.

《在币圈，不亏钱才是第一课》

很多人进币圈，都想着一夜暴富，结果一夜清零。
真正走到最后的，不是赚最多的那批人，而是最稳的那批人。

设止盈止损，不重仓、不补仓、不梭哈。

行情永远有起有落，你不可能每次都踩在点上。
能顺势而为，懂得等待，比天天追涨杀跌更重要。

在币圈，真正的高手不是每天都赚钱的人，
而是能在别人爆仓时安然无恙的人。

记住一句话——
赚钱之前，先学会不亏钱；
想走得远，就别急着跑。

subTitle:

消息层面：

巨鲸割肉，不是结束是开始？这巨鲸的操作，像极了咱们炒股被套后“死扛到补仓，最后实在扛不住割肉”的剧本。他从11月3号开始，往Hyperliquid存了221万美金，开5倍杠杆做多ZEC，一路滚仓，本金最高冲到1050万妥妥的“大多头信仰党”。结果这两天ZEC跌得狠，他扛不住了，割了3万枚，但剩下1037万美金的仓位还在水里，浮亏46%。
重点来了：他的清算价是420美元。​ 也就是说，如果ZEC继续跌到420，他剩下的仓位会被强制平仓，到时候又会砸出一波恐慌盘。你说，他会不会为了不被清算，后面继续拉盘自救？还是会彻底躺平，任由仓位被强平？这波后续动作，可能比今天的割肉更关键！
技术面：

再看咱们的ZEC一小时K线现在价格卡在516，整体趋势还是往下，但有两个信号矛盾：
空头这边：Hyperliquid上最大的ZEC空头，之前加仓到现在浮亏从2019万收窄到1087万，现在还拿着3064万美金的空单没平仓。他是在等反弹补刀，还是已经快扛不住要获利跑了？

再看MACD，白黄线在0轴下方死叉，短期空头占优，但516这个位置离第一支撑490只差26刀。如果今晚能守住490，反弹冲600的压力位不是没可能；但要是放量跌破490，那400的底部支撑就得严防死守了！你说，现在是空头占上风，还是多头在憋大招？
个人观点：600压力位被突破是大概率事件，但行情的真正关键在于490支撑能否守住。散户该如何操作？船长给出三步生存法则：（1）490支撑位附近可分批建仓，带好止损；2.若突破压力位，回踩可加仓；3.警惕MACD假死叉陷阱，关注屏蔽交易占比是否持续超30%。

Newcomers often:
Continuous jumping

Impatient during sideways

title: Биткоин растёт на фоне политических и экономических новостей из США: что стоит знать инвесторам
subTitle:
Автор новости: Crypto Emergency
Курс биткоина (BTC) демонстрирует уверенный рост — +4% за сутки — на фоне позитивных новостей из США. Главные драйверы движения: возможное завершение шатдауна, обещания стимулирующих выплат населению и запуск новых криптопродуктов с кредитным плечом на регулируемых биржах.

К 15:10 мск 10 ноября BTC вырос с $102 тыс. до $106 тыс., а совокупная капитализация крипторынка достигла $3,6 трлн. Ethereum также прибавил более 5%, поднявшись до $3,6 тыс.

«Вертолетные» деньги и налоговые льготы
9 ноября президент США Дональд Трамп пообещал выплатить каждому американцу, кроме лиц с высоким доходом, не менее $2 тыс. за счёт средств от таможенных пошлин. Такие выплаты — известные как «вертолетные деньги» — уже ранее способствовали росту крипторынка, особенно в 2020 году во время пандемии.

Министр финансов США Скотт Бессент уточнил, что выплаты могут быть реализованы через налоговые льготы: освобождение от налогов на сверхурочные, доходы от соцобеспечения и проценты по автокредитам. Также обсуждается возможность сокращения госдолга за счёт пошлин.

Завершение шатдауна и влияние на крипторынок
Сенат США одобрил законопроект о временном финансировании, который должен положить конец 40-дневному шатдауну — самому продолжительному в истории страны. В криптосообществе считают, что остановка работы правительства тормозит принятие криптовалютных законопроектов и запуск ETF на базе цифровых активов.

На фоне ожиданий завершения шатдауна рынок прогнозов Polymarket собрал более $21 млн в криптовалютных ставках, при этом 87% участников ставят на завершение между 12 и 15 ноября.

Запуск спотовых криптопродуктов с плечом
Комиссия по торговле товарными фьючерсами США (CFTC) ведёт переговоры с крупнейшими биржами — CME, Cboe, ICE, Coinbase Derivatives — о запуске спотовых криптопродуктов с кредитным плечом. Это может значительно расширить доступ трейдеров к новым инструментам.

Исполняющая обязанности главы CFTC Кэролайн Фам заявила, что новые продукты могут появиться на рынках уже до конца года.

Donald Trump published a message warning that if the Supreme Court declares his tariffs illegal, the United States would lose more than **3 trillion dollars** and suffer a national crisis. However, experts and media such as *The Guardian* and *The Washington Post* point out that the figure is an **alarmist exaggeration** without a solid economic basis. The case actually concerns whether the former president abused the emergency law (IEEPA) to impose trade tariffs without Congressional approval, something that several courts had already deemed illegal or unconstitutional.

Although a ruling against could imply **significant refunds and losses** for the government, more realistic estimates speak of **hundreds of billions**, not trillions. Trump, true to his style, turns a complex legal issue into a tale of imminent disaster, mixing economics with apocalyptic rhetoric to bolster his narrative of political victimhood and savior of the country.

His message, written in a childish and alarmist tone, reflects more of an emotional strategy than a rational analysis. By presenting any judicial setback as an existential threat to the U.S., Trump seeks to mobilize support through fear, not through arguments. In essence, the real debate is not about inflated figures, but about the **limits of presidential power** and the need for the country to distinguish between reality and exaggeration.

title: Phần thưởng lớn nằm ở đầu xu hướng — nhưng xác định nó mới là phần khó nhất
subTitle:
Ai cũng muốn “vào đầu xu hướng mới” để nhân lợi nhuận. 
Nhưng khi nào là đầu xu hướng?
Xác định đầu xu hướng cần:
Break cấu trúc (higher high/higher low) hoặc (lower high/lower low)Volume tăngDòng tiền mới
Ví dụ: sau khi Bitcoin bị thủng hỗ trợ lớn → nếu xuất hiện breakout cùng volume thì đó có thể là đầu xu hướng mới. 
Newbie nên: đừng vội mua ngay khi breakout vừa xuất hiện — chờ pullback hoặc retest để xác nhận.
Nhận diện “đầu xu hướng” đúng khiến bạn lợi hơn nhiều lần nhận “cuối xu hướng”.
Đầu xu hướng đến khi mọi người vẫn nghi ngờ — đừng mua khi mọi người đã tin.

title: Nén đa khung là vũ khí của trader chuyên nghiệp — bạn đã học chưa?
subTitle:
“Đa khung thời gian” nghe phức tạp? 
Nhưng nó là công cụ mạnh cho người mới nếu hiểu cách dùng.
Nén đa khung:
Khung lớn (D1/W1): xác định xu hướng chínhKhung nhỏ (H4/H1): tìm vào lệnh
Khi hot news xuất hiện (như Bitcoin thủng ngưỡng) → nguy cơ nhiễu rất lớn.
Vì vậy:
Trên D1: xu hướng giảm → bạn ưu tiên Short hoặc đứng ngoài SpotTrên H1: chờ breakout hoặc retest
Kinh nghiệm: người mới nên vẽ hỗ trợ/kháng cự trên D1 rồi chỉ tìm setup ở H4/H1.
Điều nguy hiểm nhất là trade khung nhỏ khi bạn không nhìn khung lớn.
Hãy nhìn “bức tranh lớn” trước khi zoom vào chi tiết.

translatedData.title: Multi-timeframe compression is a weapon of professional traders — have you learned it yet?
translatedData.subTitle:
"Multi-timeframe" sounds complicated?
But it is a powerful tool for beginners if understood how to use it.
Multi-timeframe compression:
Large timeframe (D1/W1): identify the main trend
Small timeframe (H4/H1): look for entries
When hot news appears (like Bitcoin breaking a threshold) → the risk of noise is very high.
Therefore:
On D1: downtrend → you prioritize Short or stay out of Spot
On H1: wait for breakout or retest
Experience: beginners should draw support/resistance on D1 and only look for setups on H4/H1.

title: Vòng xoáy news  hype  dump: bạn đang trong đó mà không nhận ra
subTitle:
Một dự án vừa công bố hợp tác → giá tăng mạnh → bạn mua. 
Ngày sau nghe tin không được như kỳ vọng → giá rớt.
Đó là quy trình: News → Hype → Pump → Xả → Dump. 
Người mới thường bị cuốn vào giai đoạn hype rồi chịu hậu quả. Kỹ thuật: hãy chờ retest tin, kiểm tra volume tăng trước khi mua. 
Kiểm tra: người mua lớn thực sự tham gia? hoặc chỉ người nhỏ vào? 
Nếu chỉ người nhỏ, khả năng cao là “xả”. 
Hãy xây dựng danh mục với: token đã có người dùng, có doanh thu/thanh khoản, và chỉ mua khi setup rõ.
Tin tốt là mồi – hành động của thị trường mới là câu trả lời.
Đừng mua vì “tin tốt” – mua khi bạn thấy “người mua thật”.
#BTC #ETH #crypto #trading #ClarissaCrypto

translatedData.title: The whirlpool of news hype dump: you are in it without realizing it
translatedData.subTitle:
A project has just announced a partnership → the price surged → you buy.
After hearing the news, it did not meet expectations → the price dropped.
That's the process: News → Hype → Pump → Dump → Dump.
Newcomers often get caught up in the hype phase and then suffer the consequences. Technique: wait for the retest of the news, check for increased volume before buying.
Check: are big buyers actually participating? Or are only small players involved?
If only small players are involved, it's highly likely to be a 'dump'.

title: Post 2: Inside Linea’s zkEVM Building with Trust, Not Just Speed
subTitle:
When we talk about scaling, we often talk about TPS  transactions per second as if speed alone defines progress.
But Linea’s vision goes deeper.

Linea’s zkEVM (Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine) isn’t designed just to accelerate; it’s designed to align.

What does that mean? It means everything that works on Ethereum works on Linea.
Developers can use the same contracts, same tools, same logic without changing code. That’s EVM equivalence, and it’s a cornerstone of Linea’s philosophy.

But the real magic lies in how zk proofs work.
Instead of relying on fraud proofs and week-long finality like optimistic rollups, Linea’s zero-knowledge approach provides immediate, mathematical assurance.
Every transaction is cryptographically proven correct before it’s finalized.
No waiting, no “trust me” periods  just proof.

This is a massive step toward the future of secure scaling. It’s not optimistic. It’s verified.

And that verification has ripple effects:

Faster bridging between L2 and L1.

Stronger user confidence.

Cleaner infrastructure for developers.

Lower cost and higher throughput  all without weakening security.


In essence, Linea’s zkEVM is not just a performance upgrade; it’s a paradigm shift. It makes Ethereum not only faster but mathematically trustworthy.

Linea’s zkEVM represents what blockchain evolution should look like  advancement without compromise. It’s how Ethereum scales without losing itself.

In a world chasing speed at any cost, Linea is proving that real innovation is built on precision and integrity.

#Linea  $LINEA  @LineaEth  #zkEVM  #Eth

title: Tín hiệu FOMO mạnh kèm tin tốt — là lúc bạn nên GIẢM vị thế, không phải tăng
subTitle:
Khi tin tốt + mọi người đồng loạt mua → bạn cảm thấy “mình phải vào mới không bị hụt”.
FOMO là cảm xúc nguy hiểm nhất với người mới. 
Tin tốt lan truyền → người mua tăng → volume tăng mạnh ban đầu → nhưng sau đó cá lớn có thể xả. 
Kỹ thuật: khi mức risk:reward không rõ và bạn tham gia cùng lúc nhiều người mua → rủi ro cao hơn. 
Newbie nên: nếu cảm thấy “mình nên vào vì sợ bỏ lỡ” → là dấu hiệu cảnh báo. 
Hãy rút lại, chốt lãi nếu đang có, và chỉ vào khi có setup rõ ràng.
FOMO càng mạnh — bạn càng cần tỉnh táo.
Đừng để sợ bỏ lỡ dẫn bạn vào tình huống mất kiểm soát.

translatedData.title: Strong FOMO signal accompanied by good news — is the time you should REDUCE your position, not increase.
translatedData.subTitle:
When good news + everyone buys at once → you feel like 'I have to get in so I don't miss out.'
FOMO is the most dangerous emotion for newcomers.
Good news spreads → buyers increase → initial volume spikes → but later, big players may sell.
Technique: when the risk:reward ratio is unclear and you participate while many others are buying → higher risk.
Newbie should: if you feel like 'I should get in because I'm afraid of missing out' → it's a warning sign.

🪙 The impact of the reopening of the US government on the cryptocurrency market

1. Relief and increased risk appetite
After the shutdown, investors feel more at ease → returning to riskier assets, including cryptocurrencies → a possible short-term increase of $BTC $ and altcoins.


2. Dollar vs. Bitcoin

A stronger dollar after reopening → downward pressure on cryptocurrencies.

A weaker dollar (lack of confidence in the budget) → Bitcoin often rises.



3. Fed policy
If the economy slows down after reopening, the Fed may lower interest rates → beneficial for cryptocurrencies.
Higher rates → rather negative impact.


4. Return of the SEC and regulatory decisions
After the government reopens, agencies like the SEC are operational again — they may approve cryptocurrency ETFs or issue decisions affecting the market.


5. Investor sentiment
More stability → less fear → greater demand for cryptocurrencies.




---

📊 Summary:
After the reopening of the US government, cryptocurrencies usually experience a slight increase due to improved sentiment,
but the long-term effect depends on the dollar, the Fed, and regulatory decisions.

Po otwarciu rządu agencje jak SEC znów działają — mogą zatwierdzać ETF-y kryptowalutowe lub wydawać decyzje wpływające na rynek.


5. Nastroje inwestorów
Więcej stabilności → mniej strachu → większy popyt na kryptowaluty.

Po otwarciu rządu USA kryptowaluty zwykle lekko rosną dzięki poprawie nastrojów,

title: Không phải cứ pump là bull market — nhiều khi chỉ là pump để xả
subTitle:
Bạn thấy altcoin pump nhanh + tin tốt → nghĩ “bull market mới”. 
Nhưng nhiều lần đó chỉ là cú pump để xả hàng.
Trong thị trường đang điều chỉnh: pump nhanh có thể tạo “hype” → nhiều người mua vào → rồi bị xả hoặc giá lùi. 
Người mới cần biết:
Kiểm tra volume và liquidity: coin có đủ thanh khoản để giữ không?Tokenomics có lịch unlock lớn sắp tới không?Dòng tiền lớn (on-chain) có vào hay không?
Nếu thiếu các điều kiện đó → pump có thể là bẫy. 
Kinh nghiệm: đặt mức chốt lời phù hợp, không all-in vào pump.

Pump không phải dấu hiệu bull market. Báo hiệu bull market là dòng tiền thật + thanh khoản tăng.
Xem điều kiện hỗ trợ trước khi nhảy vào pump.
#BTC #ETH #crypto #trading #ClarissaCrypto

translatedData.title: Not every pump means a bull market — often it’s just a pump to offload
translatedData.subTitle:
If you see altcoins pump quickly + good news → think 'new bull market'.
But many times that is just a pump to offload.
In a correcting market: a quick pump can create 'hype' → many people buy in → then it gets dumped or the price retreats.
Newcomers need to know:
Check volume and liquidity: does the coin have enough liquidity to hold?
Is there a large unlock schedule coming for the tokenomics?
Is there large on-chain capital flowing in or not?

title: 发行美元债却反推去美元化？中国🇨🇳这步大棋，让人民币崛起成为霸权？
subTitle:
货币变局：见证人民币崛起与全球金融新秩序
 
朋友们，一场深刻影响全球格局的金融变革，正悄然加速演进。
 
过去数十年，美元在国际货币体系中构筑的霸权地位，如今正面临前所未有的冲击。全球“去美元化”浪潮汹涌而至，其速度与广度，远超多数人的预期。
 
这一切，从备受瞩目的安氏半导体事件便可窥见端倪。面对外部挑战，中方的回应精准有力、立场坚定，向世界清晰展现了维护自身高科技领域核心利益的决心与实力。
 
紧随其后的，是一次具有里程碑意义的战略突破——中国向欧洲客户明确提出，高端芯片贸易采用人民币结算。这看似简单的支付方式调整，实则在西方长期主导的国际金融壁垒上，撬开了一道关键裂缝。在战略级物资贸易中推行本币结算，意味着我们在高科技供应链的核心环节，牢牢掌握了货币主权，从根本上动摇了美元在高端技术贸易中的绝对话语权。
 
区域合作的步伐同样令人振奋。韩国共同民主党党首李在明展现出卓越的战略远见，推动中韩达成规模高达4000亿人民币的本币互换协议。这一协议的落地，意味着中韩双边贸易将大量摆脱美元中转，直接以本币结算，不仅标志着东亚区域金融合作迈入新阶段，更以实际行动为全球去美元化进程注入了强劲动力。
 
这场货币格局的重塑，绝非孤立的区域事件，而是形成了席卷全球的连锁反应。据俄罗斯媒体报道，中俄贸易已基本实现本币结算，完全脱离西方货币体系；在俄印石油交易中，人民币结算也已成为新的选择。今年10月，中国与冰岛签署35亿人民币本币互换协议；11月，国际航空运输协会清算所正式将人民币纳入结算货币。这一系列密集举措，清晰昭示着人民币国际化已进入全面加速的新阶段。
 
数据是最有力的证明。截至今年6月底，中国已与全球43个国家和地区的央行或货币当局签署双边本币互换协议，其中32份仍在有效期内，总规模超4.5万亿人民币。在贸易领域，人民币的影响力更是持续攀升：沙特对华石油交易中人民币结算占比超45%，伊朗达60%，巴西与我国贸易的人民币结算率超三成，阿根廷接近两成。这些亮眼数据，无不印证着人民币在国际经贸舞台上的角色日益重要。
 
各国纷纷拥抱去美元化，核心原因在于，美元霸权带来的系统性风险已被全球广泛认知。美国长期利用其货币霸权转嫁国内危机、收割全球财富，导致其国际信用持续崩塌。即便是美国的传统盟友日本，也与中国保持着500亿人民币的互换协议，这一信号足以说明，美元主导的国际货币体系正遭遇前所未有的信任危机，而人民币已成为越来越多国家的务实选择。
 
更值得玩味的是，一些东南亚国家开始将黄金储备转移至中国，柬埔寨便是首批践行者。这一行为背后，是各国对现有国际金融体系信任度的下降，更是对中国金融安全与稳定性的高度认可，无疑是向中国金融体系投下的一张重磅“信任票”。
 
今年11月，中国在香港发行40亿美元主权债券的举动，更是彰显了高超的战略智慧。或许有人会疑惑：我们正在推动去美元化，为何反而发行美元债券？答案藏在双重战略考量中：一方面，为需要美元流动性却不愿受美国金融政策掣肘的国家提供了新的选择；另一方面，这也是对国际市场对中国主权信用的一次实战测试，而结果堪称惊艳——总认购金额高达1182亿美元，超额认购近30倍，其中亚洲投资者占53%，欧洲25%，中东16%，美国本土投资者亦占6%。这一数据，充分印证了国际资本市场对中国信用的高度认可。
 
这些举措的本质，是中国在现行国际金融规则框架内，通过市场化手段稳步提升人民币国际地位的智慧实践。如今，中国在稀土进口、铁矿石采购、天然气交易等关键大宗商品领域，均已实现人民币结算。这份底气，源于中国既是全球最大市场之一，也是最重要的制造业大国，是市场规律作用下的水到渠成。$ETH $SOL 
 
朋友们，我们正在亲历的，绝非零散的金融事件，而是一个时代的伟大转折。这些变化并非偶然，而是中国经济实力增强、国际地位提升的必然结果。美元主导的国际货币体系或许不会在短期内被完全取代，但世界货币多元化的趋势已不可逆转。当越来越多国家在贸易和投资中主动选择多元化货币安排，一个更加多极化的世界正加速到来。
 
在这场变革中，中国始终秉持开放包容、合作共赢的理念，稳步推进人民币国际化，这既是对全球经济发展的重要贡献，也是负责任大国的应有担当。这条路或许漫长，但方向明确、前景可期。毕竟，“天下苦美元久矣”，如今变革的曙光已然显现，我们正处在一个充满挑战，更充满机遇的新时代！$BTC

#altsesaon 
A Change in the Crypto Weather: Altcoins Might Be Making a Comeback
The crypto world is always changing and now people are talking more about something called "altcoin season." Picture a market where Bitcoin, the big boss, takes a break. Then other smaller cryptocurrencies get a chance to shine, maybe even growing investments 50 times or more. That's what CryptoELITES, a trader who knows a lot about this stuff, thinks might happen. The analysis shows we might be about to see a big change in what coins are popular. Bitcoin isn't as strong as it used to be, plus altcoins are starting to look good, so we could be about to see something like the crazy market of 2021 again.
Recent numbers from the market give a good idea of what's happening. Altcoins have jumped up fast over the last four days. Their total value went up from about $1.4 trillion. This rise happened while Bitcoin's price went down 15% over the last month. Smart investors are now moving their money to altcoins. It is riskier but they could make more money. If things go like they have before, this could be the start of huge growth.
Bitcoin Losing Control: Why Altcoins Could Take Off
Bitcoin's power is going down, which could make altcoins do well. Bitcoin has been the most important cryptocurrency for months. It had about 60% of the crypto market. But that has changed. In the last five months, Bitcoin's control has dropped a little, about 5.13%. This shows that investors are starting to feel different.
Why is this happening now? The charts show that altcoins are about to break through some important levels. They are like they were before when they went up a lot. CryptoELITES says there's a key trendline that goes all the way back to the breakout of 2020. The line is being tested again now. "Even if Bitcoin goes up for a bit, it won't change the pattern for long", he says. If this support holds, which has been there since 2019, it could send a lot of money into altcoins. This would push them up towards 2026 really fast.
This isn't just guessing. It is based on what's happening in the market. Right now, the Altcoin Season Index is at 39 out of 100. That means Bitcoin is still more popular. But even at this level, the index suggests altcoins might become more popular soon. If the index goes above 75, altcoins would be the winners. Traders like CryptoELITES think things are being prepared for that change.
Like 2020 All Over Again: History Makes People Hopeful
To understand how big this could be, think back to the end of 2020. That's when altcoin season 1.0 started. Some things happened in the world at that time. Bond yields went down, the dollar wasn't as strong, then gold prices dropped. This made some altcoins jump up as much as 50 times. It is like that time again in November 2025. The same things are happening with safe investments, which is good for riskier investments like altcoins.
CryptoELITES has a chart that compares altcoin performance to some important things. It looks at Bitcoin's power, gold prices, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY) and 10-year Treasury yields (US10Y). What does it say? These things are lining up like they did five years ago. Right before altcoins separated from Bitcoin, then went way up. "The market is following the same pattern", CryptoELITES says. Any drops haven't changed the main trend. They've only made it clearer.
Looking at the past isn't just remembering old times. It shows us what could happen. People who saw the change early made a lot of money in 2021 during the altcoin craze. The way things are set up now, we're not just dreaming. We're building on what has worked before.
How to Handle the Rise: What Are the Risks? What Can You Gain?
Remember, anything can happen. The crypto market is hard to predict. Bitcoin could go up again for a while, which would slow down altcoins. But the numbers still show that altcoins could be a good deal. Bitcoin is losing power, the value of altcoins is increasing, plus things are like they were before, all of which show that there are chances that are being ignored.
If investors are hoping to make 50 times their money, there is a clear message. Have patience but watch closely. Altcoins are testing to see if they can break out. The next few weeks will show where things are going by the end of the year. Will we see Altcoin Season 2.0 happen? Or will Bitcoin take back its place? One thing is for sure, things are speeding up. Those who pay attention could make the most money.
The crypto world is about big moves and big rewards. Altcoins might be about to become popular again. Stay alert, the show is only beginning.

The price of Ethereum is trading in a tight, narrow range right now. It is moving roughly between $3,500 and $3,680. The price is sitting right around the center at $3,580.

What the Chart Shows
Technical signals confirm the market is in a compression mode. Indicators like the Bollinger Bands are squeezing closer together. Historically, this kind of squeeze almost always comes before a significant price move. That move could be sharp, and it could go either up or down.

What the Network Shows

Bearish Breakdown: If the key support area around $3,500 fails, ETH could drop lower. It would likely fall toward $3,380 to $3,430, where many previous liquidity pockets lie.

Implications for Strategy

This is a classic "watch for the squeeze" setup. You must prepare for a sharp breakout or a sharp breakdown, rather than just assume the market will stay quiet.

Risk management is key. A fake-out risk is very real. When volatility returns, moves happen fast and often trap traders. You should use wider than usual stop-losses and ensure your strategies are ready to handle quick volatility. Do not assume a smooth march upward is guaranteed.

title: 神之所以是神，25岁超越马云，V神是怎么一步登天的？
subTitle:
要说互联网圈有几个人能做到“年轻就登顶”，那一定少不了一个名字——Vitalik Buterin，也就是大家口中的V神。25岁那年，他的成就竟然让人直呼“超越马云”，不仅是财富数字上的比较，更是一种对技术影响力的认可。今天我们就来聊聊V神是怎么一步登天的，这个故事，比你想象的还要戏剧化。


先从他的小背景说起，V神可不是土豪家庭出身，也没有传统名校光环，他出生在俄罗斯一个普通家庭，从小就展现出超乎常人的数学逻辑能力。小学的时候，他就能轻松解决复杂的算术问题，电脑编程对他来说几乎是呼吸一样自然。到了青少年时期，他的兴趣已经完全锁定在“如何用代码改变世界”上。很多人年轻的时候还在玩游戏，他却在钻研加密货币的原理，写程序，搭建小型项目。


你以为这就是普通的天才少年故事？不完全。V神的成长路径很“反常规”，高中毕业后，他并没有选择直接进入一流大学，而是因为对比特币的兴趣选择自学区块链技术。那时候，比特币才刚刚起步，很多人都还在怀疑它到底能不能成气候，但V神却像看到未来的地图一样，能精准预判区块链的潜力。他甚至在博客里公开写下“去中心化平台才是互联网下一个十年革命的主战场”，这一判断后来被证明是惊人的精准。


接下来就是他人生的第一个爆点——2013年，他仅仅19岁，就联合发布了以太坊白皮书。这里面有几个关键点值得注意，第一，他不是靠团队的名气发声，而是凭一份逻辑严密的白皮书就震惊了圈子；第二，这份白皮书不是空谈理论，而是直接给出了完整的技术架构和经济模型，让普通开发者也能参与进来。可以说，这就是V神第一次把自己“品牌化”，让全世界看到：这个年轻人，未来不容小觑。


紧接着是融资和项目落地。2014年，以太坊通过ICO（首次代币发行）筹集了超过1800万美元资金，V神才20岁出头。这一数字放到当时，足够让一大堆创业公司嫉妒到吐血。资金到位后，他带领核心团队开始构建以太坊网络，完全不依赖大公司资源，也不靠任何政府支持，完全靠技术和社区信任。很多人说这很疯狂，因为当时区块链技术仍然非常初级，安全问题、扩展性问题堆积如山。但V神却像在打游戏一样，一步步解锁技术难题，推动以太坊从白皮书走向实际部署。


到了2017年，以太坊迎来了第一个大爆发期，DeFi、NFT、智能合约的概念开始在全世界疯狂扩散。V神一度被媒体称为“区块链界的马云”，不仅因为以太坊市值飙升，更因为他的理念正在重塑整个互联网经济模型——去中心化、开放协议、人人参与，这些理念后来成为新一代创业者的标配。


但V神的“超越马云”，不仅仅是财富数字上的比较。25岁那年，他身价被估计已经超过10亿美元，而更重要的是，他的影响力已经从金融市场延伸到技术社区、投资圈乃至政策讨论中。他并不热衷炒作，也不刻意包装自己，更多的是通过技术创新和逻辑思维去改变世界。这种影响力，是马云在阿里初期无法企及的——阿里是商业模式的创新，V神则是在构建整个新型经济的底层规则。


很多人会问，V神为什么能这么快成功？总结起来有几个关键因素：

第一，技术先行。他对区块链底层技术的理解，比大多数人领先十年；

第二，前瞻性判断。早在比特币刚兴起，他就看到了智能合约的未来，这种眼光决定了他能在别人还在犹豫的时候行动；

第三，极致执行力。从白皮书到代码落地，再到社区构建，他几乎每一步都亲力亲为，不依赖外部权威；

第四，理念驱动。V神不是为了快速赚钱，他相信技术能真正改变世界，这种信念吸引了全球无数开发者加入以太坊生态。


说回他25岁的那一年，V神的生活其实一点都不像普通亿万富翁。他的日常还是写代码、参与开发者讨论、出席技术会议。他甚至坦言，自己在意的不是财富，而是“以太坊能否真正改变世界”。这种低调和专注，让他在圈子里有一种天然的威望，也让投资人、创业者和媒体无法忽视他。


当然，V神的成功也不是没有争议。有人质疑他年轻轻狂，技术路线冒险，也有人担心以太坊过度依赖个人天才。但从历史来看，每一次真正的技术革命，背后都需要这样一批敢于突破常规的人。V神显然是其中的佼佼者。


到了今天，ETH 已经成为全球第二大区块链网络，智能合约生态繁荣，DeFi、NFT、DAO等概念风靡全球。V神虽然不再是年轻小伙，但25岁那年的成就，早已奠定他在区块链历史上的传奇地位。超越马云，不仅仅是财富榜单的数字游戏，更是他用技术、理念和执行力改变整个行业格局的象征。


所以，当你看到别人谈论“年轻就能登顶”的故事，不要只看表面数字。V神告诉我们，真正的登顶，不是靠运气，也不是靠关系，而是找到一个足够大的舞台，用能力和远见去打出自己的一片天。25岁超越马云，这不是偶然，这是一个天才用逻辑和勇气一步步走出来的传奇。


V神的故事，告诉每一个年轻人：机会总是留给有准备的人，创新永远比追随更值钱，真正的影响力，是你能改变规则，而不是跟着规则跑。

title: ¿Por qué suben y bajan tanto las criptomonedas? La verdad que casi nadie te cuenta
subTitle:
Si alguna vez te preguntaste por qué el precio de Bitcoin o Ethereum parece una montaña rusa, no estás solo. La volatilidad es prácticamente una marca registrada del mercado cripto. Pero aunque esto ya sea ampliamente conocido, pocas personas entienden realmente qué provoca esas oscilaciones tan intensas.
No es raro ver una criptomoneda valorizarse 15 % en un solo día y, a la mañana siguiente, devolver todo con una caída igual de agresiva. Y no estamos hablando solo de tokens nuevos o desconocidos. Ethereum —la segunda criptomoneda más importante del mundo— cayó más de 11 % en una sola semana recientemente, con caídas fuertes y una recuperación parcial en apenas 24 horas. Movimientos que en el mercado tradicional tomarían meses, en cripto suceden en cuestión de minutos u horas.
¿Pero por qué ocurre esto?
El mercado nunca duerme: cripto opera 24/7
A diferencia de las bolsas tradicionales, que cierran por la noche, los fines de semana y feriados, el mercado de criptomonedas nunca se detiene. Funciona sin pausa: 24 horas al día, siete días a la semana, en todo el mundo. Eso significa que cualquier evento relevante —una decisión política, una declaración de un gran inversor o una crisis internacional— puede impactar los precios de inmediato, incluso si es domingo de madrugada.
Esa dinámica constante amplifica las reacciones del mercado. No hay tiempo para digerir una noticia con calma: el impacto es casi instantáneo, ya sea positivo o negativo.
Liquidez: el factor invisible que mueve (mucho) los precios
Otro punto clave para entender la volatilidad de las criptomonedas es la liquidez. En pocas palabras, la liquidez es la facilidad con la que puedes comprar o vender un activo sin modificar demasiado su precio. En el mundo cripto, muchas monedas todavía tienen una liquidez relativamente baja, es decir, no se negocian en grandes volúmenes.
Cuando esto sucede, basta con que entre una orden grande de compra o venta para provocar un movimiento brusco en el precio. Este efecto es aún más fuerte cuando hablamos de las llamadas ballenas —los grandes poseedores de criptomonedas— que tienen el poder de mover el mercado entero con una sola transacción.
Noticias y datos económicos: el combustible de las emociones
El mercado cripto es altamente sensible a las noticias. Una simple declaración de un regulador en una economía relevante, una falla de seguridad en una plataforma o un dato económico negativo puede desencadenar reacciones en cadena. Lo mismo ocurre con anuncios positivos, como la aprobación de [ETFs](https://www.binance.com/es-la/square/post/30210094340209) de criptomonedas, fallos judiciales favorables o la adopción por parte de grandes empresas.
Como buena parte de los inversionistas aún son personas naturales —el famoso "retail"—, el impacto emocional de estas noticias tiende a ser más fuerte. El miedo y la avaricia se contagian rápidamente, llevando a decisiones impulsivas que alimentan la volatilidad.
El rol del inversionista minorista: emocional y reactivo
A diferencia de los grandes fondos del mercado tradicional, muchos inversionistas de cripto todavía están aprendiendo a lidiar con la volatilidad. Es común que las personas entren al mercado motivadas por promesas de ganancias rápidas, sin preparación ni estrategia. Y cuando el mercado comienza a caer, el pánico se apodera de ellos. Así llega la clásica “venta en el piso”, cuando la pérdida se materializa por puro miedo.
Al mismo tiempo, cuando los precios suben rápido, muchos entran por FOMO (miedo a quedarse afuera), alimentando aún más la subida. Este comportamiento colectivo genera movimientos abruptos hacia arriba y hacia abajo que, más que técnicos, tienen raíces profundamente humanas.
Ethereum y sus subidas y bajadas que lo explican todo
[Ethereum](https://www.binance.com/es-LA/price/ethereum) es un ejemplo perfecto de cómo el mercado cripto puede ser impredecible. Recientemente, se negociaba por encima de los 3 900 dólares y, en pocos días, cayó a menos de 3 100 dólares, en un movimiento que asustó incluso a quienes ya conocen bien el ecosistema.

La caída fue provocada por una combinación de factores: rumores regulatorios, un aumento en las liquidaciones forzadas de posiciones apalancadas y pánico de corto plazo. Pero apenas mejoró un poco el ánimo del mercado, el activo se recuperó parcialmente, mostrando una vez más que las subidas y bajadas son parte del juego.
Entender la volatilidad es el primer paso para invertir con más consciencia
La oscilación de precios puede parecer un obstáculo para quienes están empezando, pero también es lo que genera oportunidades únicas de valorización. Los inversionistas mejor preparados saben que la clave no es intentar adivinar cada movimiento, sino entender qué factores mueven el mercado y armar una estrategia sólida.
Estar expuesto a activos con mayor liquidez, diversificar el portafolio, mantener parte de los fondos en [stablecoins](https://www.binance.com/es-LA/square/post/26803929239098) y no dejarse llevar por el momento emocional son actitudes que marcan una gran diferencia. Más importante que acertar el timing, es tener claridad sobre los riesgos y saber que, en este mercado, la volatilidad no es un error: es la regla del juego.

title: Crypto currency funds outflows hit whopping $1.2 billion, Bitcoin, Ethereum lead
subTitle:
#ETH #BTC Cryptocurrency assets funds net outflow hit a staggering $1.2 billion last week. This has been the second consecutive weekly decline in Crypto market and second largest since March. Out of $1.2 billion net outflows, the world's largest cryptocurrency Bitcoin witnessed outflows at $932 million, followed by Ethereum at $438 million, as per a report.
However, Solana managed to register $118 million in inflows last week and overall staggering $2.1 billion over the last nine weeks. Meanwhile, short Bitcoin products recorded $12 million in inflows. The amount is the highest since May 2025, The Kobeissi Letter reported.

As companies focused on stockpiling bitcoin and other major cryptocurrencies come under pressure amid market saturation and souring sentiment, new entrants are pushing into less popular tokens, stoking worries over increased volatility.
Buoyed by U.S. President Donald Trump's crypto-friendly stance and inspired by the meteoric success of Michael Saylor's Strategy, the number of publicly-traded companies investing in cryptocurrencies in the hopes they will appreciate has boomed. As of September, there were at least 200 digital asset treasury, or DAT, companies - mostly focused on bitcoin - with a combined capitalization of around $150 billion, up over threefold from a year earlier, according to an analysis by law firm DLA Piper.

Wednesday's opening directly shocked everyone! The Nasdaq futures plummeted 1.6% as soon as they opened, Bitcoin fell wildly by 6% in half an hour, and the market was filled with panic, with many investors rushing to cut losses. 

 But this drop is not really a surprise; the core issue is that funds have been withdrawn. 
 The first blow came from the Treasury's "withdrawal": the U.S. government was in a shutdown for 38 days, and the Treasury's account was running low on funds. Last week, they urgently issued $163 billion in short-term government bonds. The market needed real money to take over, directly withdrawing hundreds of billions in liquidity. The stock and cryptocurrency markets rely on funds, and the inevitable result is a loss of blood and a drop. 

 The second blow came from the Federal Reserve's "cold water": a statement that "the policy path is not yet determined" smashed the expectation of a rate cut in December from 70% directly down to 45%. Short-term funds quickly reduced leverage overnight, with concentrated liquidation driving prices down further, tightening liquidity and amplifying the downward trend. 

 The third blow is hidden in the "tightness" between banks: the Federal Reserve used the most liquidity tools since the pandemic, making overnight borrowing more difficult for banks. On the surface, the market seems to have plenty of money, but in reality, funds are locked up in government bonds and reverse repos, unable to flow into the stock and cryptocurrency markets. 

 This wave of plummeting is not the beginning of a bear market! Once the government shutdown ends and the Federal Reserve eases up, the withdrawn funds will quickly flow back. Panicking to cut losses now is equivalent to throwing chips at the low point; holding cash and focusing on oversold leading stocks is the smart move. To catch signals of fund inflows and position well, just keep an eye on subsequent developments.

title: Cryptocurrency Markets Surge as BTC and ETH Gain Over 4%
subTitle:
The cryptocurrency market experienced a notable surge on October 10th, marking a strong rebound in investor confidence. Within just 24 hours, both Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) rose by over 4%, with most altcoins following suit. This bullish momentum pushed the total cryptocurrency market capitalization up by 3.92%, reaching an impressive $3.56 trillion.
Factors Behind the Market Rally
Several factors contributed to this sudden market upswing. Analysts attribute the rise to the easing of the US government shutdown and improved liquidity conditions in global markets. The reopening of government operations and renewed fiscal flow reassured investors, encouraging them to re-enter risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
Another key driver was US President Donald Trump’s economic plan to distribute $2,000 in dividends to Americans using tariff revenue. This move boosted consumer sentiment and reinforced expectations of increased spending, indirectly benefiting digital assets as investors anticipated higher liquidity across markets.
Market Reactions and Investor Sentiment
As BTC and ETH led the charge, other major altcoins mirrored their momentum. The rally reflects a renewed sense of optimism among traders who had previously been cautious amid regulatory uncertainties and global economic tensions.
However, despite the positive news, short-term volatility remains. Data shows that while the market surged, both BTC and ETH later saw minor pullbacks of around 1.8%, signaling that traders are taking quick profits after the rally.
Strategic Outlook
For investors, this period highlights the importance of flexibility and timely market positioning. The current environment suggests a potential accumulation phase for long-term holders, especially if liquidity continues to improve and macroeconomic conditions stabilize.
Traders, on the other hand, may look to capitalize on short-term swings, setting tight stop-loss levels to manage risk. As always, diversification across leading altcoins and stablecoins can offer additional protection against sudden market reversals.
Conclusion
The recent crypto surge underscores how macroeconomic policies and government actions can significantly influence digital asset trends. With improving liquidity, positive fiscal developments, and renewed investor confidence, the crypto market may be gearing up for another strong phase — though prudent risk management remains key in navigating this ever-volatile landscape

title: "Inside Plasma: A Deep Dive into Scalable Layer-2 Architecture"
subTitle:
What it Is
Think of a friend sending you money internationally: usually there’s a bank fee, an extra wait, maybe frustration. Now imagine instead they just hit “send,” and you receive dollars almost instantly, without wondering if you have the “right token” or “enough gas.” That’s what Plasma aims to feel like.
It’s a blockchain… but one built for one thing first: making stablecoin payments smooth. You still get smart contract power (because it uses the same tech builders know), but the vibe is: move value, not just compute. If you’ve ever felt “I don’t know how to pay gas tokens” or “this transfer took sooo long,” Plasma is trying to fix that.
Why It Matters
Here’s why this actually matters to people, not just techies:
For folks sending money: Ever dealt with “oops, I forgot to get ETH for gas” or “the fee is crazy/high”? Plasma wants you to send USD-pegged coins (think USDT) and not worry about the gas token. That means easier for you, easier for your friend.
For someone running a business or side-gig: You want to pay people, receive money, send payouts with minimal headache. If you’re using crypto, you’d rather not teach everyone about “native token vs stablecoin vs gas” every time. Plasma aims to reduce that friction.
For the broader wave of crypto-for-payments: Stablecoins are becoming the money of crypto. For it to really work, the rails behind them need to act like money not just experiments. A chain built for that purpose helps bridge crypto to real-world payments.
How It Works (in plain terms)
Here’s the “how” without too much jargon:The chain uses a fast system so when you hit “send,” the transaction doesn’t drag.It’s fully compatible with the tools developers already know, so they can build faster.If you’re sending a major stablecoin (USDT, for example), the system can waive the typical “gas charge” so users don’t have to think about it.You might even pay fees in the stablecoin itself (rather than juggling another token).There’s a plan to eventually let Bitcoin holders bring their BTC into this world so you convert it (in a secure way) and then use it for payments inside this network.
Tokenomics (XPL) – The “money side”
Here’s how the native token works think of it as the “fuel & governance” token that supports the network.Total supply: about 10 billion XPL.Initial circulating amount: around ~1.8 billion.Who gets what: roughly 40% to ecosystem work (builders, incentives), 25% to team, 25% to investors, and 10% public sale (check latest docs for updates).Rewards & inflation: once staking and full validators are live, there’ll be annual inflation starting near 5% and coming down toward 3% later.Fee burning: as the network gets used more, some $XPL  gets burned (i.e., removed from supply) through fee mechanisms so usage can translate into token scarcity.Use-cases: XPL is used for gas (in more complex transactions), staking/delegation, governance decisions. If you’re just sending USDT, you might not touch XPL at all but the ecosystem still depends on it.
Ecosystem & What’s Happening
Wallets are integrating: you’ll find Plasma support in familiar wallets, meaning less guesswork for you.On-/off-ramps: exchanges are listing USDT on Plasma, making it easier to move in/out of the chain.Consumer product coming: there’s a “Plasma One” app where you might hold your stablecoins, send them, spend them. The idea is: crypto payments for real life.Developer friendly: If you know Solidity (or similar), you can build apps here without starting from zero re-use your tools, deploy contracts, but benefit from lower fees/fast chain.
Roadmap – What To Expect
What’s coming (and what to keep an eye on):Mainnet beta & $XPL live: this is when the chain goes from “interesting idea” to “usable network.”Privacy option for payments: pay someone, choose to hide the amount/recipient (opt-in). Useful for business/payouts.Bitcoin bridge: when live, you’ll bring BTC into the ecosystem (via “pBTC” or equivalent) and use it for payments/liquidity.More validators & decentralization: as the network matures, more people will secure the chain, delegate tokens, vote on changes it becomes community-driven.Merchant & global adoption: building the “rails” so you can spend, receive stablecoins globally, with familiar UX. That’s where the real-world leap happens.
Challenges (and why they’re real)
Sponsoring zero-fee transactions sounds great, but is it economically sustainable? If millions of transfers happen, someone has to pay the cost.Bridges can be weak points: The BTC bridge depends on trusted systems (verifiers, multi-signature). If there’s a flaw, risk arises.Getting people & businesses to switch: If you send stablecoins already, maybe you’re on Ethereum or Tron. Why jump? The UX must clearly beat what you’re using now.Regulation: Since stablecoins sit close to “real money,” rules can change. Chains built around them must be flexible and compliant.Token capture: If many transfers are fee-sponsored and you use stablecoins to pay fees, how much does XPL matter? The utility needs to translate into value.
Why You Might Care
Because if you’re someone who:Sends crypto to friends or family abroad,
Runs payouts or payroll in crypto,
Builds apps or wallets and wants better payment rails,
Or campaigns/content-creates in the space (you!),
Then Plasma offers a story you can believe in: crypto payments made easy, familiar, friendly.
It’s a bridge between “crypto geek things” and “money as we use it everyday.”
My take
In two sentences: Plasma could become the chain you use when you don’t want to think about the chain. You just send the dollar-coin, and it arrives. The spec is compelling; the real test will be: does it feel that smooth in your hand and in your world?

BTC, ETH, BNB & More: Layer 1 Networks Simplified ◽

Layer 1 blockchains are the base networks where transactions and smart contracts are directly processed.

Bitcoin (BTC): The original Layer 1 blockchain, mainly used for large transactions and store of value. Fees are high and transactions can be slow, so small payments often use the Lightning Network (Layer 2).

Ethereum (ETH): Layer 1 blockchain for smart contracts and dApps. Congestion can cause high gas fees and slow confirmations, so Layer 2 solutions like Arbitrum and Optimism are used to scale.

Binance Smart Chain (BSC / BNB): Layer 1 blockchain with fast transactions and low fees. Smart contracts, DeFi, and dApps are supported; Layer 2 solutions are mostly unnecessary.


Other popular Layer 1 blockchains with low fees:

Solana (SOL): High-speed, low fees, ideal for microtransactions, DeFi, and NFTs

Cardano (ADA): Efficient proof-of-stake Layer 1 with low fees

Avalanche (AVAX): High throughput and low fees, suitable for dApps and DeFi

Algorand (ALGO), Near Protocol (NEAR): Very low fees and fast confirmations

Polkadot (DOT): Focused on interoperability between blockchains

Choosing the right Layer 1 blockchain depends on your needs: BTC for store-of-value, ETH for smart contracts with Layer 2 scaling, BSC for fast and cheap DeFi, or Solana/Cardano/Avalanche/Algorand/NEAR for low-fee, high-speed transactions.

title: 新手炒币必看：那些靠 “听消息” 亏掉的钱，K 线早就提醒过你​
subTitle:
从业 5 年，见过太多新手栽在 “小道消息” 上上个月带的学员小杨，就是最典型的例子。​
刚入市时他坚信 “K 线都是忽悠，内幕消息才是捷径”，跟着所谓的 “大佬” 追涨杀跌，短短两个月账户直接缩水 40%。直到我逼着他沉下心学基础 K 线，三个月后不仅填平了亏损，还赚了 15% 的收益。​
这不是个例。在加密资产市场，懂不懂 K 线，本质是 “被市场收割” 和 “主动掌控交易” 的区别。新手别再迷信小道消息了，这 3 个 K 线核心作用，帮你避开 80% 的坑：​
1. 找对买卖信号，拒绝盲目跟风​
加密资产波动剧烈，盲目进场等同于赌博，但 K 线会给你明确的 “导航信号”：​
底部出现 “小阳接大阳” 的反转形态时，往往是多头开始发力的信号，此时进场胜率远高于盲目追涨；​
顶部出现 “大阴盖过阳线” 的压制形态时，说明空头开始主导市场，及时离场才能避免被套。​
小杨最经典的一次操作，就是在主流资产出现 “黄昏反转” 形态时，提前止盈离场，直接躲过了 1500 点的暴跌。要知道，他以前遇到这种情况，只会跟着消息慌不择路地跟风。​
2. 读懂市场情绪，不做恐慌韭菜​
每根 K 线的实体长短、上下影线，都是多空双方博弈的痕迹，读懂这些就能摸清市场情绪：​
长上影线意味着上方抛压沉重，买方无力继续推高，此时再追涨就是送钱；​
长下影线则是下方支撑强劲的信号，说明有资金在抄底，短期恐慌下跌大概率是陷阱。​
小杨以前遇到资产下跌就慌着割肉，后来学会看 K 线后，一次主流资产急跌出现长下影线，他忍住没割，果然半天后就反弹回升。这就是读懂 K 线情绪的魅力 —— 不被市场恐慌带偏，才能守住筹码。​
3. 控制风险底线，保住本金才有机会​
加密资产交易，活下来比赚快钱更重要，而 K 线就是你的 “风险警报器”：​
当资产价格跌破关键支撑位（前期低点形成的 K 线区间），就是明确的止损信号；​
合理设置止损区间，就算判断失误，也能把亏损控制在 5% 以内，不会一次被套死。​
小杨之前就是因为不设止损，一次误判就被套 30%，后来用 K 线找支撑位设止损，交易节奏彻底稳住。记住：本金是交易的根基，K 线帮你守住根基，才能在市场里长久赚钱。​
最后说句实在话​
K 线不是 “预测未来的神器”，但它是加密资产市场的 “基础语言”。新手不用学复杂的指标，先把常见的反转形态、支撑阻力位搞懂，就能避开大部分坑。​
就像小杨现在说的：“以前凭感觉交易，每天提心吊胆；现在看 K 线做决策，心里踏实多了。” 加密资产交易没有捷径，但有方法跳过 K 线这门基础课，再努力都是白费。​

🔥The U.S. government is finally about to open its doors; is this good news or bad news? It's not hard to be filled with doubts, so Brother Long will explain the pros and cons.
First, there are several good points:
First, it releases liquidity and drives up coin prices. During the shutdown, the balance in the U.S. Treasury account surged, equivalent to a large withdrawal of liquidity from the market, which restricted institutional funds, thus reducing market liquidity and causing panic. After the government reopens, the balance will decrease, and the frozen funds will slowly be released. Referring to the last shutdown, the cryptocurrency market rebounded by 10-15% historically.
Second, it eliminates regulatory and market information blind spots. During the shutdown, the U.S. SEC's approval work was almost stalled, and some altcoin ETF proposals were shelved, with funds not flowing into the market. After operations resume, the process will restart, and more institutions will continue to buy aggressively. Additionally, the non-farm data and CPI during the shutdown will also resume publication, which is an important basis for judging market direction.
Third, it attracts retail and fund capital, boosting sentiment. The uncertainties during the shutdown kept market sentiment low; this end will also improve market sentiment. Plus, Trump's announcement of a plan for at least $2,000 in tariff bonuses for each person will attract more retail funds into the market. Furthermore, the probability of a rate cut in December has risen to 73%.
However, risks must also be prevented.
Everyone knows the good news, but many institutions may learn in advance. We need to guard against profit-taking; without stable conditions, caution is best. Personally, I always maintain a small position when entering the market and operate with rolling positions, increasing funds only when the market trend is clear. Risk is always our top consideration; otherwise, whatever you earn can be lost!

title: 亲测的方法：从10w本金，一年时间，做到了1000多万，就是用这套短线交易快速盈利的方法：《日内交易+的赚钱逻辑全解析！》
subTitle:
无论是交易股票、炒币，日内交易赚取大利润的关键都是一样的。关键在于我们如何根据想要承担的风险和回报来调整我们的仓位。在这篇文章中，我们将一起探讨如何在一笔交易中，在几分钟内为你的账户增加2%-4%的收益。
如果我们能在40%的交易中盲得2%-4%(或更多）的收益，而在其他交易中只亏损1%，我们就能赚很多钱。如果我们能赢得50%或更多的交易，那就更好了。
这听起来很简单。然而，大多数人完全误解了实现日内交易大回报的概念。
大多数人认为使用大的止损（这样不会被触发）和大的止盈目标点位是赚钱的方法。但实际上，要赚取大的日内交易利润，我们需要等待小的止损机会，然后在典型的波动范围内设定目标点位，以获得良好的风险回报比。
当然，交易方式有很多种。不同的风格适合不同的个性。这是一种方法，如果适合你，它会是一个很好的选择。
以下是实现日内交易大利润的四个步骤：
1. 每笔交易风险控制在账户的1%（刚开始时可以更少)。
2.利用价格波动允许的最小止损。这听起来可能违反直觉，但没有理由继续持有表现不佳的交易。
即使止损很小，我也经常在止损被触发之前就提前止损。
3.在止损大小的2到3倍处止盈。这确保了盈利大于亏损。在某些情况下，略小的目标（1.5倍）也可以接受，较大的目标（4倍或更多）也可能适用。
4.只有在目标点位基于典型波动可达到的情况下才进行交易。
以下是这些步骤如何协同工作，基于价格的典型波动（而非运气，也不需要巨大的波动）找到高回报/风险的交易。
你可能还会注意到，实现良好的日内交易利润并不需要大量的盯盘时间或学习大量的策略。每天只需30分钟到几个小时，找到良好的风险回报机会，并使用一两种你真正擅长的策略，就能获得丰厚的利润。
1.1%风险规则
在赚大钱之前，我们需要控制风险。如果我们亏光了本金，就什么都赚不到了。
采用1%风险规则。这意味着我们每笔交易最多只能亏损本金的1%。我们可以在每笔交易中使用任意比例的本金，但单笔交易的亏损不能超过本金的1%。
例如，如果我们有一个45,000美元的日内交易账户，我们可以使用全部资金（甚至可以通过杠杆使用更多资金）来建仓，但单笔交易的亏损不能超过450美元。无论账户规模大小，这一概念都适用。
刚开始时，每笔交易的风险可以控制在0.1%。如果你在某个风险水平上连续几周盈利，可以将仓位逐步增加到0.2%、0.3%，依此类推。
需要注意的是，随着账户规模的增大，风险1%可能会变得困难，因为仓位规模会变得非常大。但到那时，你已经赚得盆满钵满，所以这不再是个问题。
2.市场允许的最小止损
我们现在知道了每笔交易最多可以亏损多少美元，即账户的1%。
接下来，我们需要等待那些能够提供小止损机会的交易触发点。
止损是一种当价格达到指定阀值时自动平仓的订单。它是控制每笔交易风险的最简单方法之一。
这也是很多人犯错的地方。
让我们看看两位交易者：一位是专业日内交易者，另一位是新手。
下图（1分钟图表）展示了一个可能的交易机会。入场点很好。价格在开盘后不久呈现上升趋势，随后回调，交易者在价格再次开始上张时入场。这是我最喜欢的趋势交易策略之一。
新手交易者因为不想亏损，所以选择使用较大的止损。他们将止损设置在当日开盘价或当日低点下方。在这种情况下，他们的止损距离入场点有5.46%，即0.78美元。

他们认为自己很聪明，因为将止损设置在一个主要波段低点下方，价格需要大幅下跌才能触发止损。
回想一下，我们的交易者允许亏损450美元。他们在这笔交易中每股风险为0.78美元，因此他们可以买入576股（450美元÷0.78美元）。
专业交易员并不那么担心亏损。他们知道，无论止损设置在哪里，亏损交易都会发生，因此他们更倾向于使用较小的止损，这意味着更大的仓位规模。如果他们判断错误，他们会迅速退出，不会在一个没有潜力的交易中浪费时间。
专业交易员入场是因为价格正在上涨，因此他们选择将止损设置在刚刚形成的波段低点下方。止损距离入场点仅为1.75%，即0.25美元。这比新手的止损小了1/3。
止损的大小会因交易和资产的不同而有所变化，因此具体数字并不重要。重要的是新手和专业交易者止损大小的对比。

最大亏损金额为450美元，但专业交易员的止损仅为0.25美元，因此他们可以买入1800股。
在不了解其他信息的情况下，如果价格上涨，谁会赚更多钱？
当然是专业交易员，因为他们持有1800股，而新手只有576股，尽管他们都在冒着450美元的风险！
3.以止损或风险的倍数为目标
对于新手来说，情况会变得更糟。他们不仅冒着与专业交易员相同的风险，却持有更少的币种，而且也不太可能实现专业交易员的回报。
理想情况下，我们希望在一笔盈利交易中赚取止损大小的2倍、3倍、4倍或5倍。由于我们的止损代表账户的1%，如果我们能赚取2倍或3倍，我们就能为账户带来2%或3%的收益。但止损越 大，实现这一目标就越难！
炒币时，我喜欢将目标设定为止损的2.5倍（1.5倍到3倍）。对于炒币，我将止盈目标设定为止损的2到3倍。让我们看看这对专业交易者来说会如何运作。

效果非常好。与当天的波动相比，0.25美元的止损规模相对较小，因此价格上涨0.62美元至0.63美元（4.37%）以达到目标（2.5x0.25）并不算太难。我们将在下一步中更详细地讨论我们可以合理预期的盈利目标。但现在，我们的专业交易员在这笔交易中赚取了账户的2.5%，而交易仅用了14分钟。他们甚至可以在5分钟内赚取2%。
而对于新手来说...情况并不理想。事实上，尽管币种上涨了，并且他们在理论上判断对了方向，但他们的账户从未显示出超过1%的盈利，随后小幅盈利也消失了。

新手最终以亏损或微薄利润离场，而这只是他们所承担风险的一小部分。如果他们能在价格跌至止损之前离场，可能会赚取100美元到300美元（尽管他们冒着450美元的风险）。
而专业交易员则轻松赚取了1125美元，并在价格再次下跌之前早早离场。
新手试图“不亏损”并使用较大的止损，这使得他们几乎不可能在账户上实现大幅盈利。
专业交易员使用较小的止损，使得价格更容易达到止损的倍数，从而在几分钟内为账户赚取2.5%的收益（这笔交易仅使用了他们资金的一半多一点...剩余资金可以用于另一只币种的交易）。
4.只有在目标/倍数可达到时才交易
我们如何知道什么是合理的目标？
新手的止损大小超过5%，这意味着价格需要上涨10%才能达到2:1的目标。这种情况发生的频率有多高？即使发生了，通常会在几分钟内实现吗？
专业交易员的目标是否合理？对于这只股票来说，是的。最佳日内交易币种通常在开盘和收盘之间波动约12%。专业交易者捕捉4.37%的波动比新手试图捕捉10%或15%的波动要容易得多。
专业交易者可能会在一天内多次捕捉到3%或4%的价格波动。
更简单的方法是观察当天价格波动的幅度，这样你就可以估计价格波动的幅度，然后在设定盈利目标时保持保守，设定一个较低的目标。
MARA在最初的上涨中上涨了1.23美元，涨幅为9%。随后它回调并再次开始上涨。如果我们做多，我们假设价格会再次上涨，但为了保守起见，我们希望目标位于之前波动幅度之内（小于9%）。
专业交易员的目标是止损的2.5倍，仅需要价格波动达到上一次上涨波动的2/3左右。因此，专业交易员实际上使用了保守的目标，但仍然为账户赚取了2.5%的收益。而新手使用了不切实际的目标，远超出当天典型的波动范围，因此他们赚得很少甚至亏损。

关于日内交易实现大额利润的最终建议
无论是日内交易炒币时，同样的概念都适用。
如果某个资产的波动较小(例如，EURUSD每天仅波动约1%，而原油或某些股票每天可能波动5%或更多）那么可能需要使用杠杆才能在交易中承担账户1%的风险。对于波动性较大的资产，我们可能只使用部分资金来承担1%的风险。然而，这一切都是平衡的，这就是为什么一个市场并不比另一个市场更好。一旦你理解了本文讨论的概念，所有市场都提供了同等的盈利潜力。
每天仅进行一笔交易也可能实现大额利润。这笔交易可能只持续几分钟。大额利润并不需要投入大量的盯盘时间尽管我们确实需要投入一些时间来发现机会。
相反，大额利润的关键在于设定我们的风险限制，等待市场提供一个小止损的机会（止损越小，仓位规模越大，同时仍然只承担账户1%的风险），然后根据当天的价格行为或资产的波动特性，在止损的倍数处获利了结。
在模拟账户中尝试一下，每笔交易都需要时间和练习来确定合适的仓位规模、正确下单以及评估哪些机会值得把握。

币圜散户痛点总结及其解决方法
一、没耐心
不会空仓、看不得别人赚钱、急于抄底、总想一夜暴富
深层原因：对市场规律认识不足，渴望快速获利
应对策略：制定投资计划，训练投资心态，学习价值投资+理念
二、没纪律
不止盈：反抽不卖、顶部不抛
不止损：死打到底、侥幸心理、弱势乱补仓
太贪心
深层原因：贪心，缺乏理性和既定投资纪律
应对策略：建立止盈止损机制，加强投资知识学习，定期复盘
三、恐惧
没有自己的投资逻辑：专做消息面、病急乱投医
操作失误：反转不变、牛市不捂、底仓不抗、频案换币
投资分散：多币同仓、本金少币种多
深层原因：对市场不确定性过度担忧，缺乏信心
应对策略：研究基本面，学习技术分析+，进行心理建设
四、追涨杀跌
深层原因：受羊群效应+影响，缺乏独立思考
应对策略：学习投资理念，控制交易频率，建立反思机制
在币圆玩来玩去说白了就是一场散户与庄家的较量，你如果没有前沿消息，没有一手资料，只能被割！想一起布局的，一起收割庄家的可以来

XRP has officially triggered a Death Cross, with the 50-day SMA dropping below the 200-day SMA.
This isn’t some rumor — it’s right there on the chart. Loud and clear. 
For those who know TA, this setup usually means the market could be heading into a big bearish wave.
But the real question is…
👉 Are you ready to move while everyone else freezes?

📊 The Charts Are Screaming
Death Cross is one of the scariest signals in the market.
It shows short-term momentum flipping bearish — and history proves it can lead to deep corrections before recovery.
Right now, XRP looks heavy:
50-day SMA < 200-day SMA
RSI & MACD both turning red
Volume fading as smart money steps back

 Smart Money Already Knows
Institutions aren’t waiting for headlines — they’re already adjusting positions.
You can literally see it: big sell walls on exchanges, funding rates going negative.
Retail still holding on, hoping it’s “just a dip.”
That’s usually when the real move starts. 
If you’re on Binance or tracking via Square-linked tools, keep an eye on order flow — it’s showing more than the charts.
---
 Panic or Opportunity?
Here’s the twist — every Death Cross eventually turns into an opportunity.
Historically, these shakeouts are where long-term believers start loading up.
If XRP stays above $2.00–$1.90, it could build a strong base before the next leg up.
But if it breaks below that… expect a full-on capitulation flush. 
---
 What’s Next?
A daily close above $2.50 could kill the bearish vibe and flip sentiment fast.
If the 50-day SMA crosses back up, this “Death Cross” might turn into a Golden Reversal.
Until then — get ready for volatility, liquidation spikes, and the whales playing their game.

昨天跟一位炒币大佬喝茶聊天，他说从30W进币圆，亏损一度只剩7W，到现在资产千万。帮他改变命运的是，坚持学习，提高认知。并总结了6条心得，含金量满满，希望刷到的朋友有所启发。
1、早盘大跌不要急着止损，通常是前晚利空过度反应，可以等待后市的修复和反转。盘尾大涨不可盲目追涨，一些主力喜欢试盘和诱多，次日低开打压吸筹。
2、运用好成交是这个实用的技术，量能可以看出后市走向，缩量持续涨，说明主力控盘极强，缩量下跌，恐慌盘没出，冰点没达到，所以还会继续跌。
3、学会看板块顶部结构，通常的，板块行情由五浪形成，一浪打出跟风盘，二浪洗盘调整，三浪是主升浪，四浪复杂分歧，五浪抬拉出货，在此过程中，三浪涨幅最大，一浪次之，五浪最低。但行情千变万化，可能没有五浪天折的也不在少数，不能死记硬背。发现板块龙头滞涨后，补涨行情时不再延续之前力度，较大概率是见顶了。
4、每次大饼顶部加速期，都会看到某个板块山寨大涨，从而引发大饼反转变盘，只需翻翻各大龙头表现是否止跌反升，那指数后续也跟随回升。
5、专一专注才好入门，特别是刚进入市场的新韭菜朋友，研究一种打法，熟练掌握其中技巧，比同时学十八般武艺要收获得多，贪多必失，学艺不精很容易被市场教训。不要随意切换模式，沉下心去学，慢慢会渐入佳境，实现稳定盈利后，再去学更多的技巧，才好融会贯通。
6、走势运行分三种结构，上、下、横，上升阶段，所有技术指标胜率都会提高，而盘整阶段，利用支撑压力高抛低吸更有效率，下跌趋势，大部分指标都失效。不同阶段使用不同的工具对付，才好胸有成竹。
我是铭哥，历经多轮牛熊，在多个金融领域都有丰富的市场经验，关注铭哥在这里，穿透信息的迷秀，发现真实的市场。更多财富密码机会的把握，发现真正有价值的机会，别再错过后悔！#ETH

title: 币圈“空气币”泛滥的核心根源解析：韭菜狂欢背后的三重原罪
subTitle:
币圈乱象丛生，空气币、垃圾币如野草疯长，究其本质，是市场生态失衡与人性弱点共振的必然结果，其背后藏着三重无法回避的核心原因。
 
1. 用户认知荒漠，投机成风：95%的参与者缺乏基础的区块链知识与项目鉴别能力，投资逻辑完全建立在“追涨杀跌”之上。哪个币短期暴涨就蜂拥而入，哪个概念热门就盲目跟风，这种非理性的投机氛围，让项目方无需打磨技术、创造价值，只需通过资金拉盘就能轻松收割，为空气币的滋生提供了最肥沃的土壤。
​
2. 侥幸心理作祟，沦为待宰羔羊：多数投资者被套后，不愿面对亏损事实，反而心存“等待解套”的幻想，放弃了及时止损的最佳时机。这种被动的“躺平”心态，不仅让自己深陷泥潭，更降低了项目方的收割成本，使其得以从容出货、全身而退，形成“割了一茬又一茬”的恶性循环。
​
3. 优质项目稀缺，劣币驱逐良币：在海量的加密货币中，真正具备实际应用场景、稳定盈利能力，且能将项目收入持续赋能于币价的优质项目凤毛麟角。绝大多数项目仅靠白皮书画饼，缺乏技术支撑与商业闭环，本质上就是一场“零和游戏”。当市场缺乏足够多的优质标的时，空气币便趁虚而入，挤占了正常的市场空间。
 
归根结底，币圈的净化不仅需要监管的完善，更需要投资者自身认知的觉醒。远离幻想，理性判断，才能在这场布满陷阱的游戏中，守住自己的本金。$BTC $ETH $SOL

Clearly, if the mid-Bollinger Band on the daily chart cannot be effectively broken, we are likely to see a phase of decline ahead. The strategy needs to be adjusted in a timely manner: if the lower support at 103000 is broken again, one can position for short trades, initially targeting around 101800; if the support stabilizes effectively, then the rebound can be aimed at around 106000. #eth 
 Ethereum is considered one of the most prominent platforms that has significantly contributed to the development of decentralized applications (dApps) and smart contracts, through several key aspects:

1. **Smart Contracts**:
   - Ethereum introduced the concept of smart contracts, which are programs that run on the blockchain and execute automatically when certain conditions are met. These contracts allow transactions to occur without the need for a third party, reducing costs and speeding up the process.

2. **Development Environment**:
   - Ethereum provides an integrated development environment for programmers to build dApps. Ethereum uses a special programming language known as "Solidity," making it easier for developers to create innovative applications based on smart contracts.

3. **Scalability and Flexibility**:
   - Ethereum is designed to be scalable, meaning developers can build a variety of applications that encompass multiple fields such as finance, gaming, and e-commerce. This diversity enhances the use of Ethereum in various projects.

4. **Interaction with Other Cryptocurrencies**:
   - Ethereum allows decentralized applications to interact with many other cryptocurrencies easily, enhancing its use in a larger ecosystem. dApp users can execute transactions using different currencies within the same platform.

5. **Secure Infrastructure**:
   - Ethereum relies on blockchain technology that provides a high level of security.

#eth 
 إيثيريوم تعتبر من أبرز المنصات التي ساهمت بشكل كبير في تطوير التطبيقات اللامركزية (dApps) والعقود الذكية، وذلك من خلال عدة جوانب رئيسية:

1. **العقود الذكية**:
   - إيثيريوم قدمت مفهوم العقود الذكية، وهي برامج تعمل على سلسلة الكتل (Blockchain) وتنفذ تلقائياً عند استيفاء شروط معينة. هذه العقود تتيح إجراء المعاملات دون الحاجة إلى طرف ثالث، مما يقلل من التكاليف ويسرع من العملية.

2. **البيئة التطويرية**:
   - توفر إيثيريوم بيئة تطوير متكاملة للمبرمجين لبناء dApps. تستخدم إيثيريوم لغة برمجة خاصة تُعرف بـ "Solidarity"، مما يسهل على المطورين إنشاء تطبيقات مبتكرة تعتمد على العقود الذكية.

3. **التوسع والمرونة**:
   - إيثيريوم مصممة لتكون قابلة للتوسع، مما يعني أنه يمكن للمطورين بناء تطبيقات متنوعة تشمل مجالات متعددة مثل التمويل، الألعاب، والتجارة الإلكترونية. هذا التنوع يعزز من استخدام إيثيريوم في مشاريع مختلفة.

4. **التفاعل مع العملات الرقمية الأخرى**:
   - تتيح إيثيريوم للتطبيقات اللامركزية التفاعل مع العديد من العملات الرقمية الأخرى بسهولة، مما يعزز من استخدامها في نظام بيئي أكبر. يمكن لمستخدمي dApps إجراء معاملات باستخدام عملات مختلفة ضمن نفس المنصة.

5. **البنية التحتية الآمنة**:
   - تعتمد إيثيريوم على تقنية سلسلة الكتل التي توفر مستوى عالٍ من الأمان.

quoteContent.title: 前贝莱德高管Joseph Chalom称以太坊是华尔街的“基础设施”
quoteContent.bodyTextOnly:
Odaily星球日报讯 Sharplink 联合首席执行官、前贝莱德数字资产战略主管 Joseph Chalom 表示，以太坊并非只是又一个区块链，而是华尔街最终将赖以构建（金融）基础设施的基石，金融机构看重的信任、安全性和流动性，以太坊都具备，这让他将职业生涯押注于此。他表示，以太坊上有大量稳定币、资产代币化和智能合约活动，是实现金融数字化的可信之链。

Sharplink 是几家积累以太币的数字资产财务公司之一，但 Chalom 认为，大多数公司都难以实现规模化发展，如果没有强劲的交易量、干净的资产负债表以及管理质押和投资的内部团队，许多公司的表现都将不尽如人意。Chalom 并不认为 Sharplink 是对其贝莱德职业生涯的背离，而是他使命的延续：将传统金融与加密货币生态系统连接起来，因以太坊能更快、更低成本、更安全地重建体系。他视以太坊为下一波金融数字化浪潮的基础，未来将统称“金融”，而以太坊是其背后基础设施。（CoinDesk）

translatedData.body: Former BlackRock executive Joseph Chalom calls Ethereum the 'infrastructure' of Wall Street
translatedData.bodyTextOnly:
Odaily Planet Daily reports that Sharplink co-CEO and former BlackRock digital asset strategy head Joseph Chalom stated that Ethereum is not just another blockchain but the cornerstone on which Wall Street will ultimately build its (financial) infrastructure. Ethereum possesses the trust, security, and liquidity that financial institutions value, which is why he has bet his career on it. He noted that there are a large number of stablecoins, asset tokenization, and smart contract activities on Ethereum, making it a trusted chain for achieving financial digitalization.

Sharplink is one of the few digital asset financial companies that accumulate Ethereum, but Chalom believes that most companies struggle to achieve scalable growth. Without strong trading volumes, clean balance sheets, and internal teams managing staking and investments, many companies' performances will be unsatisfactory. Chalom does not see Sharplink as a departure from his BlackRock career but rather a continuation of his mission: to connect traditional finance with the cryptocurrency ecosystem, as Ethereum can rebuild systems faster, at lower costs, and more securely. He views Ethereum as the foundation of the next wave of financial digitalization, which will be collectively referred to as 'finance', with Ethereum being the underlying infrastructure.

title: BAM, Alpenglow, Firedancer: Tiga Senjata Solana Lawan Ethereum & L2
subTitle:
$SOL 
{spot}(SOLUSDT)
Solana sedang membangun fondasi baru untuk menjadi tulang punggung pasar modal internet. Roadmap mereka hingga 2027 menekankan kecepatan, keadilan, dan infrastruktur kelas institusi - bukan sekadar janji, tapi langkah konkret yang bisa mengubah persepsi pasar terhadap SOL.
Upgrade Alpenglow di akhir 2025 akan memangkas finalitas transaksi dari 12 detik menjadi 150 milidetik. Dengan menghapus Proof of History dan mengadopsi voting validator off-chain, Solana membuka pintu bagi aplikasi trading yang butuh settlement instan. Bagi saya, ini krusial: institusi tidak akan masuk jika latensi masih jadi penghalang. Namun, migrasi ini berisiko - koordinasi ribuan validator harus sempurna agar tidak ada downtime.
Lalu ada Block Assembly Marketplace (BAM) dari Jito Labs, dijadwalkan Q1 2026. Mekanisme lelang MEV ini akan mendistribusikan 30% pendapatan ke validator dan staker, sekaligus mencegah praktik predatory. Ini langkah cerdas untuk menjaga ekosistem tetap adil, meski keberhasilannya bergantung pada adopsi searcher.
DoubleZero Fiber Network sudah berjalan di testnet. Jaringan fiber khusus ini memangkas latensi di bawah 1 milidetik bagi validator institusi. Saat ini baru 3% stake yang terhubung, tapi potensinya besar untuk menarik firma algo-trading. Kekhawatiran saya: jika hanya pemain besar yang mampu akses, sentralisasi bisa memburuk.
Firedancer dari Jump Crypto menjadi penutup. Validator client baru ini menargetkan 1 juta+ TPS per core - 30 kali lebih efisien dari klien lama. Jika integrasinya mulus tahun 2026, Solana bisa benar-benar unggul dalam throughput.
Secara keseluruhan, roadmap ini bukan gimmick. Ini upaya sistematis menjembatani DeFi dengan TradFi. Tapi eksekusi adalah segalanya - pantau tingkat adopsi validator dan revenue on-chain pasca-upgrade. Jika berhasil, SOL berpotensi merebut kembali narasi “Ethereum killer”. Jika gagal, celah baru akan terbuka bagi kompetitor.
#solana #defi #eth

#ETH  Purebred cattle and horses' underdogs counterattack, reborn to slaughter in the cryptocurrency world, from 20,000 to 1.5 million: Making money in the crypto world is not about talent, but about 'diligent effort':
	
Many people rush into the crypto world, only focused on 'making quick money': endless trends to chase, countless insider tips to hear, and relentless market bets, creating a battlefield every day, yet most end up losing badly.
I managed to turn a 20,000 capital into 1.5 million in three months, not thanks to extraordinary talent or insider information, but four words—diligent effort.
It’s not about shrewd predictions of rises and falls, nor busy frequent trading, but about the practice of 'slow, steady, and patient':
While others place over ten trades a day chasing rises and falls, I only do 2-3 trades at most, not being greedy;
While others frantically grab soaring altcoins, I just focus on 2-3 mainstream coins, not following the trend;
While others operate chaotically in excitement over candlestick charts, I’m like a machine without emotions—waiting patiently when necessary, and striking decisively when the moment comes.
My execution logic is extremely simple yet stable:
① Lock in targets without wavering: Focus on 2-3 long-term projects I believe in, regardless of the noisy trends, I never randomly switch coins;
② Fixed entry and exit prices: Set buy and sell points in advance, and firmly avoid acting until the price hits, executing decisively when it does;
③ Never go all in on positions: Only use 1/5-1/3 of my capital for each operation, leaving room to endure the next wave of volatility;
④ Pre-set profit and loss limits: Think through the worst-case scenario before placing orders, and stick to the rules without making last-minute changes.
Why can the 'diligent method' actually win?
Smart people often love to frequently increase their positions, predict the market, and bet on big directions, but they often end up losing everything; while 'diligent people' rely on 'slowness' and 'patience', enduring the tug of emotions and withstanding market fluctuations.
Sharing my real experience:
Initially, I only had 50,000, and I also experienced small gains and losses in the early stages, even a significant drawdown that dropped my account directly to over 20,000.
But I didn’t panic, nor did I recklessly increase my position or change the rules; I executed step by step according to my established plan.
No miracles, no shortcuts, all thanks to daily execution; in two years, my account steadily doubled and then doubled again, ultimately reaching 1.3 million.
Can this method be replicated? Yes, but there’s a prerequisite:
You must endure loneliness and resist temptation—
When it rains, there’s an umbrella; when it’s dark, there’s light; there’s a path underfoot. Will you follow or not?

#ETH 纯种牛马的屌丝逆袭，重生之我在币圈大杀四方，2万干到150万：币圈赚钱，拼的从不是天赋，而是“笨功夫”:
	
很多人闯进币圈，眼里只盯着“赚快钱”：追不完的热点、听不完的内幕、赌不完的行情，天天搞得像上战场，最后却大多亏得狼狈。
而我能从2万本金3个月做到150万，靠的从不是天赋异禀，也不是小道消息，而是四个字——笨功夫。
不是预测涨跌的精明，也不是频繁操作的忙碌，而是“慢、稳、忍”的修行：
别人一天开十几单追涨杀跌，我一天最多2-3单，不贪多；
别人疯抢飞天的空气币，我只死盯2-3个主流币，不跟风；
别人看K线热血上头乱操作，我像台没感情的机器，该等就死等，该出手就一击即中。
我的执行逻辑简单到极致，却能稳稳落地：
① 锁定目标不摇摆：只盯2-3个长期看好的项目，任凭热点喧嚣，绝不乱切币；
② 进出场价写死：提前定好买入、卖出点位，没到价坚决不动，到价果断执行；
③ 仓位绝不梭哈：每次只用1/5-1/3仓位操作，留足余地，才能熬过下一波波动；
④ 止盈止损前置：挂单前就想好最坏结果，规则定死，挂出去就绝不临时修改。
为啥“笨办法”反而能赢？
聪明人总爱频繁加仓、预测行情、赌大方向，最后往往全军覆没；而“笨人”靠“慢”和“忍”，熬过了情绪的拉扯，扛住了市场的波动。
分享我的真实经历：
初始本金只有5万，前期也经历过小赚小亏，甚至一次大回撤，账户直接跌到2万多。
但我没慌，也没乱加码、没改规则，照样按既定计划一步步执行。
没有奇迹，没有捷径，全靠日复一日的执行力，两年时间里，账户稳步翻倍再翻倍，最终冲到130万。
这套方法能复制吗？能，但有个前提：
你得忍得住寂寞，耐得住诱惑——
下雨有伞，天黑有灯，脚下有路，你跟不跟？

Ethereum is at a make-or-break point. If the bulls defend the $3,360 support and reclaim $3,550, we could soon witness a powerful breakout toward $3,700+.

Fed Officials Divided on Timing and Extent of Future Rate Cuts

The U.S. Federal Reserve is showing clear internal fractures as officials debate how soon — and how far — to proceed with additional interest rate cuts. After two consecutive 25-basis-point reductions brought the federal funds rate to 3.75%–4.00%, policymakers remain sharply divided on the next move.

Chair Jerome Powell has signaled caution, warning that further easing is “far from guaranteed” amid stubborn inflation and delayed economic data caused by the ongoing government shutdown. Some members argue the cooling labor market calls for deeper cuts to sustain growth, while others urge restraint, concerned that inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target.

The most recent policy meeting highlighted the split, with dissenting votes on both ends — one pushing for a larger 50-basis-point cut, another for no change at all. This unusual divergence has left markets uncertain about the Fed’s trajectory heading into December.

Last but not least:
The widening divide within the Fed underscores the delicate balance between supporting a slowing economy and maintaining inflation discipline. With limited data and mixed signals, the central bank may adopt a “wait-and-see” stance in December, prioritizing clarity over speed in its next policy move.

Final Word
The market doesn’t punish dips. It punishes denial. Control your patience before chasing profit — and you’ll never trade from fear again.

title: Tăng mạnh nhưng funding rate phình to — đó là dấu hiệu NGUY HIỂM!
subTitle:
Nhiều đồng tăng mạnh ngày 11/11 nhưng funding rate tăng đáng kể.
Funding cao = nhiều người long → crowded trade → rủi ro bị quét.
Khi funding quá cao:
Market-maker có động lực “xiết”Short squeeze → rồi long trap → nến đâm
Cách xử lý:
Không long đuổiTìm short hedge ở vùng kháng cựQuan sát funding + Open Interest
Kỹ thuật:
Nếu giá tăng + OI tăng + funding cao = rủi ro trapNếu giá tăng + OI giảm + funding thấp = bền hơn
Funding cao không phải tín hiệu tốt — mà là cảnh báo crowding & biến động mạnh sắp đến.

translatedData.title: Strong increase but funding rate expands significantly — that is a DANGEROUS sign!
translatedData.subTitle:
Many coins surged on 11/11 but funding rate increased significantly.
High funding = many people long → crowded trade → risk of being swept.
When funding is too high:
Market-maker has the incentive to 'squeeze'
Short squeeze → then long trap → candle spike
Handling method:
Do not chase long
Find short hedge at resistance level
Observe funding + Open Interest
Technique:If price increases + OI increases + high funding = trap riskIf price increases + OI decreases + low funding = more sustainable

translatedData.title: Good news = price increase? Wrong! If good news comes late, the price has already moved ahead!
translatedData.subTitle:
Fiscal stimulus + financial easing often causes crypto to rise — but most of it is already reflected in the price.
Newbies often think: “Good news → buy immediately!”.
But the market always moves ahead of the news.
The usual price reflects expectations → when the news comes out, it's just a confirmation.
Consequences:
Chasing purchases → getting stuck
Not preparing the entry zone
Tips:
Note the time when the news is leaked
Monitor price reactions, not just the content of the news
When the news comes out and the price doesn't rise → be careful, it has already been fully reflected

translatedData.content:
Former BlackRock executive claims ETH is the cornerstone of Wall Street's future financial "infrastructure"

Recently, former BlackRock digital asset strategy head and current Sharplink co-CEO Joseph Chalom stated in a media interview that Ethereum is not just a blockchain project, but the cornerstone for Wall Street financial institutions to build future financial infrastructure.

Chalom emphasized that Ethereum possesses the trust, security, and liquidity required by financial institutions. This makes him firmly believe that it meets the core needs of financial institutions and is a trustworthy chain for achieving financial digitization.

He particularly highlighted that Ethereum has gathered the vast majority of global stablecoins, tokenized assets, and high-quality smart contract activities, making it the only trustworthy blockchain platform for institutions to advance the process of financial digitization.

In addition, unlike Bitcoin’s positioning as a “store of value,” Ethereum has also been positioned by him as a “multi-purpose” platform that can support financial transactions, lending, NFTs, and complex applications.

In his view, Ethereum not only provides a faster, cheaper, and safer opportunity for major institutions to reconstruct the financial system, but it is also the foundation for the next wave of financial digitization.

Currently, the Sharplink company where Chalom works holds over 3 billion USD in ETH and has partnered with organizations such as Consensys, Linea, and EigenLayer to stake its idle holdings for approximately 3% annualized returns.

Furthermore, Sharplink is exploring a "re-staking" strategy aimed at unlocking more yield potential while keeping assets in regulated custodial institutions. This model allows institutional investors to gain DeFi-level returns without the risks of directly participating in decentralized finance.

Chalom also admitted that while many digital asset companies are accumulating ETH, most institutions find it difficult to achieve scalable growth. He believes that strong trading volume, a healthy balance sheet, and a professional internal team are key success factors.

Overall, Chalom's forward-looking perspective not only indicates the integration of DeFi and TradFi but also points the way for the digital transformation of the entire financial industry. With technological advancements and regulatory maturity, Ethereum's key role as financial infrastructure will propel the financial industry into a new stage of development.

#ETH

前贝莱德高管称 ETH 是华尔街构建未来金融“基础设施”的基石

近日，前贝莱德数字资产战略主管、现Sharplink联合首席执行官Joseph Chalom 在接受媒体采访时表示，以太坊不仅仅是一个区块链项目，而是华尔街金融机构构建未来金融基础设施的基石。

Chalom 强调，以太坊具备金融机构所需的信任、安全性和流动性。这让他坚信，其既满足了金融机构的核心需求，也是实现金融数字化的可信之链。

他特别强调，以太坊上聚集了全球绝大多数的稳定币、代币化资产和高质量的智能合约活动，这使其成为机构推进金融数字化进程中唯一值得信赖的区块链平台。

此外，与比特币 “价值储存手段” 的定位不同，以太坊给还被他定位为可支持金融交易、借贷、NFT 及复杂应用的 “多用途” 平台。

在他看来，以太坊不仅为各大机构，提供了一个可以更快、更便宜、更安全地重建金融体系的机会，也是下一波金融数字化浪潮的基础。

目前，Chalom 任职的 Sharplink 公司持有超 30 亿美元 ETH，且已通过与 Consensys、Linea、EigenLayer 等机构合作，将其闲置持仓用于质押，以获取约 3% 的年化收益。

此外，Sharplink正在探索"再质押"策略，旨在释放更多收益潜力，同时将资产保留在受监管的托管机构中。这种模式使机构投资者既能获得DeFi级别的收益，又不必承担直接参与去中心化金融的风险。

Chalom还坦言，虽然目前多家数字资产公司都在积累ETH，但大多数机构难以实现规模化发展。他认为，强劲的交易量、健康的资产负债表以及专业的内部团队是成功的关键要素。

总的来说，Chalom的前瞻性视角不仅预示着 DeFi 和 TradFi 的融合，也为整个金融行业的数字化转型指明了方向。随着技术的进步和监管的成熟，以太坊作为金融基础设施的关键角色，将推动金融行业进入一个全新的发展阶段。

#ETH

What to watch / Risks

The breakdown of support at ~US $3,590 indicates vulnerability; without recovery, ETH may test lower support zones. 

Momentum from technical indicators appears weak; one analysis suggests “momentum favours bears” unless ETH finds strong support. 

Crypto markets remain volatile and influenced by broader macro/risk sentiment — a downturn in overall risk appetite would weigh heavily on ETH.


My view (short-term)

Bullish scenario: If ETH can re-claim and hold above ~$3,600–3,700 and move into the supply zone convincingly, it may aim toward ~$3,800+ in the near term.

Bearish scenario: If support fails to hold and momentum remains weak, a retracement toward ~$3,300–3,400 (or even lower) is plausible.

Bottom line: ETH currently offers a moderate-risk opportunity with some upside potential, but it’s not low-risk — there is real downside risk if support zones break.

RSI is just an indicator → needs to be combined with:
Volume
Trend
Market structure
Technical:
RSI decreases but price remains flat → divergence
